scenario_summary: Customer is requesting a refund for a service subscription 4 days past the standard 30-day refund window due to travel.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Lakisha Jackson and I'm 42. I'm trying to get a refund for a service I canceled 34 days ago. I know your refund policy is usually 30 days, but I was traveling and only just saw the charge — I didn't realize it had gone through until now. Is there anything you can do?

Hello Lakisha, thank you for reaching out. I understand you're looking for a refund on a charge that occurred just outside our standard 30-day window due to your recent travel. I'd be happy to look into this for you. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the email address associated with your subscription?
Sure, my account number is 8849201 and the email is l.jackson@email.com.

Thank you, Lakisha. I have successfully verified your account. I can see the subscription cancellation was processed on the 34th day. While our 'Terms of Service, Section 4.2' typically limits full refunds to a 30-day window, I can see you have been a loyal customer for three years with no prior refund requests. I am authorized to make a one-time exception for this situation.
Oh, that would be wonderful. I really appreciate you taking my situation into account.

It is my pleasure to help. I have just processed a full refund of $49.99 back to your original payment method. You should receive a confirmation email shortly, and the funds typically appear in your account within 3-5 business days depending on your bank. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you so much for the quick help!
You are very welcome, Lakisha. Thank you for being a valued member of our community. Have a wonderful day!

resolution_summary: The agent verified the account, acknowledged the policy, and exercised discretionary authority to grant a one-time refund exception for a loyal customer.
